Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting certain natural resource agencies from exceeding federal requirements in economically distressed counties.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring natural resource agencies to useavailable federal standards in counties with very high unemploymentrates; adding a new section to chapter 43.21A RCW; adding a new sectionto chapter 77.04 RCW; creating a new section; and declaring anemergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that there are severalcounties in the state that are characterized by very high levels ofunemployment and poverty. The legislature further finds that economicstagnation is the primary cause of this high unemployment rate andpoverty; that the stagnation is often intensified by burdensome andconflicting regulatory programs that prevent communities from beingeconomically competitive in the statewide, national, and globaleconomies; and that natural resource agencies, including thedepartments of ecology and fish and wildlife, continue to develop andadopt state rules, guidelines, permit conditions, and policies thatsubstantially differ from those that have already been adopted byfederal agencies. p. 1 SB 6224 For these reasons, the legislature intends to ensure that statenatural resource agencies, when acting in counties characterized byvery high levels of unemployment, do not exceed existing federalrequirements or policies when implementing programs for which federalrequirements or policies exist. The legislature declares that thislimited policy serves the vital public purpose of facilitatingemployment opportunities and reducing poverty in distressed areas ofthe state.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Regulatory activities undertaken by the department in counties inwhich the commissioner of the employment security department finds thatthe county unemployment rate is eight percent or more may not exceedthe standards required by federal law, regulations, or guidelines thatare applicable to the same activity or subject matter. Regulatoryactivities covered by this section are those implementing a federal lawor regulation either delegated to the state or specifically required bystate law to be implemented by the department including: Issuing anypermit, condition, order, guideline, or policy or interpretivestatement; adopting any rule; or entering into any agreement orcontract to implement such regulatory actions.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Regulatory activities undertaken by the department in counties inwhich the commissioner of the employment security department finds thatthe county unemployment rate is eight percent or more may not exceedthe standards required by federal law, regulations, or guidelines thatare applicable to the same activity or subject matter. Regulatoryactivities covered by this section are those implementing a federal lawor regulation either delegated to the state or specifically required bystate law to be implemented by the department including: Issuing anypermit, condition, order, guideline, or policy or interpretivestatement; adopting any rule; or entering into any agreement orcontract to implement such regulatory actions.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
